author: GTA6hater069
quote: After 13 years of hype, Rockstar delivered a buggy, 30fps slideshow that constantly drops you through the floor and clips through walls. The “Bonnie and Clyde” romance turns the whole game into an unskippable boyfriend simulator with padded, on-rails missions and almost none of the chaotic fun the series used to have. Performance is choppy, crashes eat progress, and the world feels more like a tedious life sim than Grand Theft Auto. Massive disappointment.
